Literature uniqueness is not logically proven by search.

value.rationale: Natural complete homotopy and rational symmetry classification of the canonical Petersen graph at its ordinary four-cut parameter. The twelve induced pentagons supply exactly the missing four-dimensional simplices and show why a complete-skeleton/high-girth shortcut cannot apply. The integral wedge rank and Specht multiplicities give natural structural information beyond Euler characteristic and beyond existing two/three-cut classifications.
